repaired_contact_row_contract.vector_derivative: the R118-conformant deterministic symmetric whole-function q/v derivative

anchor_rebase_contract.yaw_delta: apply the frozen hybrid stencil only to continuous nearest-branch orientation deltas local to the current anchor
anchor_rebase_contract.accepted_rebase: ties-to-even quantize q, canonicalize quaternion, lift yaw on the nearest continuous V9 branch, rederive every v/a/FK/collider/contact fact, then rebuild the local function and derivative at zero
anchor_rebase_contract.rejected_state: discard every unaccepted float and emitted state before the next decision
